tools.name: tick_next_runs
tools.description: Use when you or the user just wrote a cron expression (GitHub Actions, Vercel cron, Cloudflare Cron Triggers, systemd, an agent schedule) and need the next fire times before claiming it is correct. Pass the expression and an IANA timezone (default UTC). Returns the next N runs as local wall times an

tools.name: tick_matches
tools.description: Use when you need a yes/no on whether a cron expression would fire at a specific instant in a timezone — for example before shipping a schedule that crosses a DST transition, or to verify a single expected fire. Example: {"expression":"0 9 * * 1-5","timezone":"America/New_York","at":"2026-11-06T14:0
